ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organ is also called midriff?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image is an anatomical diagram of the respiratory system; the trachea can be seen in the middle going downward into the lungs on both sides, ribs are marked on both sides of the thorax, and below the lungs there is an arc-shaped, dome-shaped structure separating the thoracic cavity and the abdominal region. Reasoning: The question asks “which organ is also called midriff”. In human anatomy, midriff refers to the diaphragm located below the lungs and separating the thoracic cavity and abdominal cavity, namely diaphragm. Therefore the answer is diaphragm.
